scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.mjs && tsc -b && node scripts/bundle.mjs && node scripts/standalone.mjs
scripts.fmt: oxfmt packages scripts examples docs verification *.md && oxlint --config .oxlint-format.json --fix packages scripts examples
scripts.fmt:check: oxfmt --check packages scripts examples docs verification *.md && oxlint --config .oxlint-format.json packages scripts examples
scripts.test:browser: pnpm build && pnpm build:examples && vitest run packages/renderer-dom/test/browser-suite.test.ts
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm fmt:check && pnpm test
scripts.build:offline: node scripts/offline-build.mjs && node scripts/bundle.mjs --offline && node scripts/standalone.mjs
scripts.build:examples: pnpm --filter @gneh/example-playground build && pnpm --filter @gneh/example-snapshot build && pnpm --filter @gneh/example-vite build && pnpm --filter gneh-story build
